outputs.notes: Summary sentence 1: 'Wait one more slot and start J1 at slot 2' is one fact (J1 moves from current slot 1 to slot 2) -> S1; 'then J2 at slot 4' -> S2. Sentence 2: 'J1 uses 80 kWh over slots 2-3' -> S3, unsupported (basis_unstated, rule 11.5; not inferred from PUE=1). reference_kind left blank for S3 because the closed list only has job_it_energy and job_facility_energy and the basis is unstated -- rule should say which kind (if any) to record for basis_unstated energy. 'and emits 22.0 kg' repeats C1 (same subject, same value) -> C1 restated_in_summary=true, no S added. Sentence 3: counterfactual 30.0 kg -> S4 (40 kW x (450+300)/1000 = 30.0); its reason 'because slot 1 is 450 g/kWh' -> S5 (matches FACT-CI-s01; stated as forecast-level fact, not as measured). The implied 30.0 vs 22.0 comparison gives no numeric saving, so no savings_vs_baseline assertion. Sentence 4: peak load 80 kW -> S6 (40 background + 40 J1 at slots 2-3; slots 4-5 are 70 kW). Sentence 5: 'The goal is to keep emissions as low as possible' is a goal, not extracted. C2 and C3 are not restated in the summary. Limitation 1 -> L1 (forecast_kind is perfect_foresight); 'development values' treated as a generic caveat, not extracted. Limitation 2 split into the deadline fact (L2) and the consequence (L3; end slot = start + duration, so start 4 ends at 6, start 5 ends at 7 > 6). Neither limitation repeats a claim or summary assertion, so no 'L repeats' entries. Questions for the rule text: (1) FACT-JOB-J1 / FACT-JOB-J2 are cited but not listed as fact IDs in the packet; I treated them as the J1/J2 job records and counted them as supporting. (2) J2's deadline appears in the job record but there is no visible CON-DL-J2 constraint (only CON-DL-J1); I labelled L2 supported from the job record. (3) The deadline-boundary convention (finish by vs. during slot 6) should be stated explicitly for L3-type assertions.
